verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a search feature across to-dos, docs, and comments, nor any claims about search speed or accuracy. Everything Views (aggregating items of one type across projects) and keyboard navigation shortcuts are adjacent browsing features, not search. A community remark about the product not feeling 'snappy' concerns general UI speed and is not about search.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can search across all tasks, docs, and comments and get fast, accurate results
